title: [29.x]- Bug 647007 Copy Document on a Purchase Credit Memo 'Quantity Received', and 'Quantity Invoiced' reverted back on original Purchase Order
summary: Posting a purchase credit memo made by copying a posted invoice no longer reverts the received and invoiced quantities on the original purchase order. GetPurchaseInvoiceLine now skips the Order No. fallback for inventory item lines with no linked item ledger entry, while the corrective credit memo flow still reverts as designed.
key_points: New IsCorrectiveCreditMemo helper adds an early exit in Purch. Cr. Memo Line GetPurchaseInvoiceLine
For inventory item lines with no linked item ledger entry, the Order No. / Order Line No. fallback is skipped
Corrective credit memos that apply item ledger entries still revert the order as before
Table change made in the W1, NA, BE, ES, FI, GB, IT, NO, APAC, RU and SE layers
Tests added in W1, NA, BE, CZ and IT; background posting tests adjusted
quote: when there is no linked item ledger entry and the line is an inventory item, skip the Order No. / Order Line No. fallback
